Close leads to the open items
  • Close on a thread or topic with open items opens this list of them; Close stays off until none are left. The General topic has no Close
  • Select to dismiss, in any message's menu, opens the same selection over the whole inbox. Dismiss is a separate action from Close
  • Action items are never dismissed: they close only with Done, so they get no selection circle and Select all skips them
  • Dismissed items go through the 3 s undo, read Dismissed in History, and the agent is never told no
